description: Side panel that hosts the full document-commenting experience. Provides Open/Mentions/Resolved filter tabs and a thread list, and drills into a selected thread to show its comments and a composer for replies.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Callback invoked when a thread asks the parent to navigate to its page.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Callback invoked when selected thread id changes.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Whether replies are allowed on resolved threads.

parameters.name: MentionUsers
parameters.description: Current user id for mentions and active reactions.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when editing a comment is requested.

parameters.name: OnEditRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when reopening a thread is requested.

parameters.name: OnReactionToggled
parameters.description: Callback invoked when deleting a comment is requested.

parameters.name: OnReopenRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when resolving a thread is requested.

parameters.name: OnResolveRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when a reply is requested.

parameters.name: OnThreadNavigateRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when toggling a reaction is requested.

parameters.name: OnDraftChanged
parameters.description: Notifies the parent that the panel's comment draft state changed. The reply and edit composers hold their text in private fields the host cannot observe through a parameter. Fires ONLY when the TmCommentDraftState value actually changes (value-equality dedup), never on every keystroke. IsEditorOpen is true while the reply composer is mounted (a thread is selected) or an edit is open; EditingCommentId carries the id of the comment under edit; HasUnsavedContent aggregates both - the reply text counts only while the reply composer is mounted, and for an edit it means the text differs from the comment body as it was when the edit started. The reply draft is cleared whenever the reply composer unmounts (selection change, clear selection, starting an edit). Pair with HasUnsavedDraft for polling and DiscardDraftAsync for the discard.
